name: AI Development Control Center — CHECKPOINT-2 foundation
objective: Define PROJECT-CONTRACT-V1 as the machine-readable project source of truth before roadmap or Issue generation.
problemStatement: Without a versioned project contract, roadmap and Issue generation would rely on prompt prose and could silently rewrite governance boundaries such as scope, risk, and Human gates.
successCriteria: ProjectContractV1 can be parsed with fail-closed structural validation
Semantic validation rejects scope conflicts and weakened Human gates
Authority fingerprint is deterministic and excludes metadata.observedAt
npm run verify passes without Planner, Roadmap, IssueProposal, GitHub Issue mutation, or Agent execution

notes: Human gates remain mandatory in V1
Planner / Roadmap / IssueProposal / GitHub Issue mutation / Agent execution = NOT IMPLEMENTED
